versionDecision: Live gates on the version are only the root package contract (package.json = CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION, package-lock version and packages[""] = package.json). The index ?v= query and stage_3_execution_state.releaseVersion were pinned only by the archived stage-1-closure validator and the archived Stage 3 release lifecycle. The Stage 3 execution state is Stage 3 history and keeps 0.24.89; the Stage 4 version is written to project_version.js (single source of truth), package.json, package-lock.json and the index query by this record, and the records check requires every pin to equal the latest applied Stage 4 release. No new global, catalog, check or Stage 3 transition field.
